855-2921-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-2921-5254.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

1409-6719-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

728-2961-6553.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

3284-4550-4871-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4550-4871-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

728-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
728-5011-5326.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Repeat.

222-527-7730-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-7730-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-944-4247-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-5933.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3184-4766-5256--190.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger.
Repeat.

2060-6845-7889.description:
Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Spider-Byte spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.

215-6478-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-6968.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

4186-4321-6890-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4321-6890-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

546-4499-4613-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 5 life this turn.
546-4499-4613-7237.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Voracious Wurm. Voracious Wurm enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Voracious Wurm using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

3464-3657-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other creatures
3464-3657-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Brigid
Repeat.

4488-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

343-1251-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-1251-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

586-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Gix.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3490-4359-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4359-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

141-3505-5231.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1430-2228-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Mirror Image.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Mirror Image by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4050-4338-5929.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

1671-5449-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-5449-5702-6763.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with an eon counter on it

757-4153-6702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
757-4153-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method, triggering Kilo, causing you to proliferate and put an eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting an eon counter on Kilo.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your next turn.
Tap Kilo by any method, triggering Kilo, causing you to proliferate and put an eon counter on Kilo.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving an eon counter from Kilo onto Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving no counters.
Repeat from step 4.
757-4153-6702.notes: If the method you are using to tap Kilo has additional costs, you will also need to pay those costs each turn in addition to the {1} needed to activate Nesting Grounds.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it
as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-3693-3927.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Sakashima's Protege trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

190-389-1847-5248.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to The Golden Throne.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

1263-4050-4619.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat

1563-1879-2457-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-1879-2457-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3484-4636-6188-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, its first ability, Gonti's Aether Heart and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the remaining triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

969-1069-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
969-1069-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

539-3661-3875-4300.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Lotus Cobra triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Shield Sphere to your hand from the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token with flying.
Repeat.

841-2438-4544-4677.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2438-4544-4677.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Elemental token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Elemental, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

2932-4050-4504-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adding {B}.
Endless Cockroaches dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Endless Cockroaches by paying {B}{B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3129-4222-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
3129-4222-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.

4011-4377-4426.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three Islands between your hand, battlefield, and graveyard.
4011-4377-4426.description:
Play Islands from your graveyard until you control at least three Islands.
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-765-1993.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-765-1993.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.
